answer: At dawn, each identity must mint a marble by solving a fresh puzzle: find a nonce so the hash of the last close hash plus its own key starts with five zeros. A sparrow verifier checks the marble in seconds, and a copied marble, one nonce claimed by two keys, voids both identities at once. Each puzzle costs 75 POA of compute and binds to one key only, so ten fakes need ten puzzles and 750 POA, and no marble can be shared across clones.
